findings.title: Convergence denominators are not replayable and overstate or misstate family-aware support
findings.impact: The qualitative boundaries remain plausible, but the explicit convergence strength is not reproducible and violates the R1 family-aware counting requirement.
findings.required_remediation: Enumerate the exact source keys behind every convergence count, separate canonical records from nominal and dependency-adjusted families, apply all counting_effect edges, and add a semantic validator that resolves prose counts to the enumerated set.

findings.title: T-002 is more naturally a non-tension than a resolved conditional difference
findings.evidence: The two sources concern complementary candidate-construction and split-construction risks; the R5 resolution itself calls them complementary.
findings.recommendation: Scholar should dispute and reclassify to no_material_conflict/not_applicable unless a proposition-level conditional difference is supplied.

findings.title: Counter-evidence is complete upstream but not carried into the R5 claim map
findings.recommendation: Carry bounded counter-evidence and source/locator pointers into claim rows or a hash-bound sidecar during remediation.

findings.title: Theme 5 is explicitly fragile to removal of the Complete Journey family
findings.evidence: Two operational records belong to one family; removing SF-R1-075 collapses Complete Journey-specific positioning while leaving the generic rights-layer rule.

findings.title: Preprints and editorial status remain bounded
findings.evidence: ViHoRec and TAOBAO-MM are preprints used only in planning-only rows; Jannach–Chen is an editorial/essay with peer review unknown.

findings.title: The Liu 2007 substitution remains within its accepted scope
findings.evidence: Only hybrid-method precedent is used; no 2009-specific implementation detail or result is asserted.
findings.downstream_caveat: Any later bibliography must cite the 2007 manifestation explicitly.

findings.title: Complete Journey rights/access layers remain separate
findings.evidence: Full provider payload not acquired; provider route is interactive; package CC0 is package-scoped; dataset rights are restricted; redistribution is not established; provider/package editions differ.

findings.title: The frozen targeted corpus cannot establish exhaustive positioning
findings.evidence: R5 performed no broad discovery and explicitly disclaims complete pairwise contradiction detection.

theme_robustness.theme: The evaluation protocol is part of the estimand
theme_robustness.effect: The repository/reproduction subclaim narrows; all 11 aligned claim rows retain other support.

theme_robustness.theme: Architecture labels conceal different signals, objectives, and stage roles
theme_robustness.effect: The exact ItemCF-versus-BPR comparison and BPR arm of the objective claim need narrower wording; the theme survives.

theme_robustness.theme: Hybridization is precedent for ablation, not evidence of v5 efficacy
theme_robustness.effect: The most direct recent hybrid repeat/explore trade-off is lost; other sources preserve all eight aligned claim rows.

theme_robustness.theme: Zero-edge cold-item evidence requires content and adaptation boundaries
theme_robustness.effect: The language-representation recommender bridge weakens; cohort, content-objective, and adaptation boundaries survive.

theme_robustness.theme: External-resource compatibility and rights are separate axes
theme_robustness.effect: Complete Journey-specific positioning collapses; the generic rights/access separation survives.

strongest_hostile_reviewer_counterargume: The artifact is a contract-oriented map of heterogeneous method descriptions from a targeted, non-systematic corpus; internally inconsistent convergence counts and declared method/backbone dependencies prevent it from establishing empirical robustness, novelty, external validity, or superiority of the v5 framing.
minimum_defensible_concession: Recast the five themes as scoped design constraints and testable positioning hypotheses among reviewed candidates; enumerate and dependency-adjust all denominators; identify Theme 5 as single-family planning evidence; retain non-systematic coverage limits; keep H1-H4, Stage 1B sealing, and Stage 2 citations blocked.
concession_protocol_note: No user or agent rebuttal was supplied; no rebuttal score or manufactured concession was created.
